event.description: Train the fully shared transform at feed-forward width 15
event.proposal: Family: feed-forward width. Current retained frontier is 2,128 parameters at 99.140000%, a +0.140000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 13 prior attempts in this family. The most recent accepted in-family result is attempt-0022, projection-free width 10 with independent feed-forward paths at 3,040 parameters and 99.85%; the most recent failed in-family result is attempt-0028, direct width-15 pruning under shared QKV but independent feed-forward paths, which scored 0.00%. Attempts 0029 and 0030 have since established a fully shared-transform architecture. Hypothesis: fresh training can distribute the recurrent feed-forward computation across 15 channels even though deleting a channel from a specialized independent-path checkpoint failed; reducing the single shared width 16->15 yields 2,096 parameters. This is more informative than width 14 because width 15 is the exact nearest capacity boundary, and more informative than another checkpoint prune because it tests learnability under the retained sharing topology.
